## DPStyleARWebLive.stopProcess() method

Stop the processing module and release its resources. This method stops the inference subsystem and releases all processing-related resources. The camera module remains unaffected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
stopProcess(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the processing module has been stopped.
